outcome.name: member_not_found
outcome.message_template: The requested member does not exist.

rationale: If the member id in the URL is invalid the UI shows a clear 'Member not found' message.

outcome.name: account_not_found
outcome.message_template: The specified savings account could not be located.

rationale: When the sub‑account code is wrong or has been closed the page displays 'Account not found'.

outcome.name: permission_denied

params.text: You do not have permission to view this account

outcome.message_template: Permission denied for reading the savings balance.

rationale: A security check can block the view and the UI shows an explicit permission error.
When the session times out the app redirects to the login page; the URL pattern reveals this.

outcome.name: maintenance_notice
outcome.message_template: Temporary maintenance notice – retry after a short wait.

rationale: Occasional maintenance banners appear; they can be dismissed or retried.

outcome.name: balance_not_rendered
outcome.message_template: Balance cell not yet rendered – retry loading.

rationale: If the page is still loading the balance cell may be absent; a retry can succeed.

outcome.name: unexpected_error
outcome.message_template: The application hit an unexpected error – manual investigation required.

rationale: Generic error banners indicate a failure that automation cannot recover from.
